name: Exorcist
description: You specialize in hunting your order’s hidden enemies, knowing that an open mind is an unguarded fortress.
feature_names: Skill, Judgment Order Benefit

name: Oracle
description: Corruption has deep tendrils that can be missed, leading you to specialize in uncovering clandestine threats to your order.
feature_names: Skill, Judgment Order Benefit

name: Paragon
description: Without a strong example and a firm hand, the weak will be corrupted. You specialize in setting an example for your order.
feature_names: Skill, Judgment Order Benefit

name: Earth
description: Earth is the element of permanence. Earth abilities bolster your body and grant the power to permanently create and shape physical terrain.
feature_names: Earth: Acolyte of Earth, Motivate Earth, Skin Like Castle Walls

name: Fire
description: Fire is the element of destruction. Fire abilities devastate enemies and melt objects to slag.
feature_names: Acolyte of Fire, Return to Formlessness, Explosive Assistance

name: Green
description: Green is the element of creation and growth. Green abilities make and manipulate plants, fungi, and other forms of life to hamper foes and nourish your allies.
feature_names: Acolyte of the Green, It Is the Soul Which Hears, Breath of Dawn Remembered

name: Void
description: Void is the element of the mystery. Void abilities warp space and reality, allowing you to teleport, create illusions, and make things incorporeal.
feature_names: Acolyte of the Void, A Beyonding of Vision, Shared Void Sense, Subtle Relocation

name: Berserker
description: You channel your rage into expressions of physical might, acting as a living version of the forces that reshape the world.
feature_names: Skill, Kit, Primordial Strength, Lines of Force, Growing Ferocity

name: Reaver
description: You channel your rage into instinct and cunning, challenging the false order of civilization.
feature_names: Skill, Kit, Primordial Cunning, Unearthly Reflexes, Growing Ferocity

name: Stormwight
description: You channel your rage into the form of animals and primordial storms.
feature_names: Skill, Beast Shape, Relentless Hunter, Furious Change, Aspect of the Wild

name: Chronokinetic
description: Your training unmoors you from temporal reality, allowing you to use the flow of time as another dimension that all things move through.
feature_names: Lore Skill, Chronokinetic Mastery

name: Cryokinetic
description: You can tap into absolute cold, the most essential energy of myriad manifolds, and manifest its effects in your body.
feature_names: Crafting Skill, Cryokinetic Mastery

name: Metakinetic
description: You learn to see through the illusions of the universe to more fully understand your body and its psionic potential.
feature_names: Exploration Skill, Metakinetic Mastery

name: College of Black Ash
description: The College of Black Ash founded the art of being a shadow. Its graduates use Black Ash sorcery to teleport around the battlefield in clouds of soot, and to manipulate and create darkness. Graduates of the college are unmatched in mobility.
feature_names: Skill, Black Ash Teleport, In All This Confusion

name: College of Caustic Alchemy
description: The College of Caustic Alchemy teaches its students recipes for the acids, bombs, and poisons used in their grim work. Graduates of the college are exceptional assassins.
feature_names: Skill, Coat The Blade, Smoke Bomb, Defensive Roll

name: College of the Harlequin Mask
description: Graduates of the College of the Harlequin Mask learn illusion magic, which they use to infiltrate enemy strongholds and create orchestrated chaos in combat.
feature_names: Skill, I’m No Threat, Clever Trick

name: Insurgent
description: Doing your duty, playing fair, and dying honorably in battle is your opponent’s job. You’ll do whatever it takes to keep your allies alive.
feature_names: Intrigue Skill, Covert Operations, Advanced Tactics

name: Mastermind
description: You have an encyclopedic knowledge of warfare, viewing the battlefield as a game board and seeking victory by thinking steps ahead of your opponents.
feature_names: Lore Skill, Studied Commander, Overwatch

name: Vanguard
description: You have learned the stratagems of ancient heroes, letting you lead from the front lines and seek victory through sheer force of will and personality.
feature_names: Interpersonal Skill, Commanding Presence, Parry

name: Chronopathy
description: Chronopathy abilities allow you to view future and past events, and to manipulate time to aid allies and hinder foes.
feature_names: Accelerate, Again

name: Telekinesis
description: Telekinesis abilities allow you to physically manipulate creatures and objects.
feature_names: Minor Telekinesis, Repel

name: Telepathy
description: Telepathy abilities allow you to communicate with, read, and influence the minds of other creatures.
feature_names: Feedback Loop, Remote Assistance

name: Auteur
description: You seek drama from story and recount, using your magic to manipulate the sequence of events unfolding before you.
feature_names: Skill, Blocking, Dramatic Monologue, Turnabout Is Fair Play

name: Duelist
description: Drama infuses your every movement done in tandem with another. You perform dances of death, putting trust in your opponent to return your passion in kind.
feature_names: Skill, Acrobatics, Star Power, Riposte

name: Virtuoso
description: You find drama in music and song, weaving magic between vibrations and filling the audience with your pathos.
feature_names: Skill, Power Chord, “Thunder Mother”, “Ballad of the Beast”, Harmonize
